item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4-Final #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:11 AM, 23 October 2026(Friday)

All Thunderstorm Advisory over NCR-PRSD forecast area are now TERMINATED. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 9:23 PM, 22 October 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (San Pascual, Batangas City, Bauan, Mabini, and Lobo) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Batangas (Tingloy) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
